title: Units modulo powers are invariant under algebraically closed base change
statement: Let $k\subseteq k'$ be an extension of algebraically closed fields [def-sc-field-extension], let $C$ be a smooth affine connected curve over $k$ [def-sc-curves], and let $n\geq1$. Then pullback induces an isomorphism $\mathcal O_C(C)^\times/\mathcal O_C(C)^\times{}^{\,n} \xrightarrow{\sim} \mathcal O_{C_{k'}}(C_{k'})^\times/\mathcal O_{C_{k'}}(C_{k'})^\times{}^{\,n}$.

proof.text: Choose c by IsConnectedCurve.exists_smooth_properCompactification and give C and c.Z after base change their connected-curve and smooth instances using baseChange_curve.

Apply affine_unit_divisor_base_change to obtain the function-field maps with germ compatibility and the boundary-point bijection e. Its last two clauses give compatibility of boundary divisor maps d,d′ with unit pullback p and equality of their images under Finsupp.domCongr e. Form monoid homomorphisms into the multiplicative type tags of the boundary divisor groups.

Apply boundary_divisor_kernel_powers over k and k′ to see that each divisor kernel consists of nth powers. The proved private quotient_powers_equiv constructs the quotient homomorphism induced by p. Injectivity: if p(a)=b^n, choose c with i(d(c))=d′(b) using equality of divisor images; then d(a/c^n)=1, so a/c^n=z^n and a=(zc)^n. Surjectivity: for b choose a with i(d(a))=d′(b); then d′(b/p(a))=1, so b/p(a)=z^n and the classes of b and p(a) agree. MulEquiv.ofBijective supplies the equivalence, whose representative equation is definitional.

lean.statement: theorem units_quotient_base_change (k k' : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [Field k'] [IsAlgClosed k'] [Algebra k k'] (C : Scheme.{u}) (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve f] [Smooth f] [IsAffine C] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : ∃ e : (Γ(C, ⊤)ˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom n : Γ(C, ⊤)ˣ →* Γ(C, ⊤)ˣ).range) ≃* (Γ(pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))), ⊤)ˣ ⧸ (powMonoidHom n : Γ(pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))), ⊤)ˣ →* Γ(pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))), ⊤)ˣ).range), ∀ a : Γ(C, ⊤)ˣ, e (QuotientGroup.mk a) = QuotientGroup.mk (Units.map (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k')))).appTop.hom.toMonoidHom a)
